svg.title: Free Plan: isometric
svg.desc: Isometric of a floor slab carried on a regular grid of slender columns, with curved and straight partitions placed freely on it without regard to where the columns stand, because no wall carries load. Source: After Le Corbusier's Dom-ino frame (1914) and "Five Points" (1926). Original drawing by Project Exodus.

g.text: PARTITIONS FREED FROM THE STRUCTURAL GRID
SOURCE: After Le Corbusier's Dom-ino frame (1914) and "Five Points"
